_notes: Delivery record for a finished loop leg. Whoever consumes the scene (an exporter, a downstream DCC, another artist's agent) must never have to guess the coordinate system or which nodes are the deliverable.
Generate this file FROM THE FINAL SCENE with a read-back script (node/object paths, prim and point counts, bounding boxes). Do not type the numbers.
A consumer re-measures the per-object read-back and checks that the member totals equal readback_totals. If they do not, the membership list is wrong.
Forward slashes, relative paths from the working folder, ASCII only. Delete the _notes keys if you like; nothing reads them.

scene.ground: assets rest on the XZ plane at y = 0
scene.axis_read_back: bbox height of asset_a is the Y extent (1.84 m)

dressing_inventory: asset_a members only; comparison copies, variants other than the default, probes and backdrops excluded

excluded_helpers.why: null with packed dimension prims, not part of the asset

hidden_in_saved_scene.why: linked flipped comparison copy, tagged comparison_only
alternate variant; a dedicated collection shows the hide at a glance, prefer it over per-object hide flags (Blender: hide the collection, enable it per render layer)

readback_totals.note: the leg's own total from its final read-back; the sum of per_object_readback prims over the visible members
